prompt:
The section file sections/social-feed-counts.liquid shows a grid of social media posts. Above the grid it prints a count line such as "Showing 1 post" or "Showing 6 posts", choosing between a singular and a plural label set by the merchant. The markup is already correct and must not be changed. Its {% schema %} block uses the wrong setting ids and has an incomplete range setting. Replace the schema JSON so it is exactly the following, with keys and array items in this order.

Top-level keys:
- name: "Social feed"
- tag: "section"
- class: "social-feed"
- settings, presets (described below)

Settings (5 items, in this order):
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Follow us".
2. type "range", id "posts_count", label "Number of posts", min 1, max 12, step 1, default 6. These are numbers, not strings. The minimum must be 1 so the singular label can be shown.
3. type "text", id "label_singular", label "Label for one post", default "post".
4. type "text", id "label_plural", label "Label for several posts", default "posts".
5. type "checkbox", id "show_count", label "Show post count", default true.

presets: a single preset with name "Social feed".

Do not add blocks or any other keys. Change only sections/social-feed-counts.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
